title: Tool-loop response extraction can return a pre-tool response instead of the final answer
reasoning: FullResponseEvent is described in-code as the LLM response for the current iteration, but the extractor only accepts the first non-empty full response and then refuses to overwrite it. In a tool loop, an earlier iteration may produce a tool-calling response before ToolCallEvent/ToolOutputEvent, while a later iteration produces the actual final answer. Because final_response remains non-empty, the later full response is ignored and StreamingCompleteEvent returns stale pre-tool content.
recommendation: Track response text per assistant iteration and reset/replace it when a tool call occurs, or prefer the last assistant response observed before StreamingCompleteEvent. Add an explicit test covering a first FullResponseEvent followed by a tool call and then a final FullResponseEvent.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the shown code has no local assertion for multi-iteration tool-loop response selection.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a fake AgentSession whose process_query yields FullResponseEvent('calling tool'), ToolCallEvent, ToolOutputEvent, FullResponseEvent('final answer'), StreamingCompleteEvent, then assert extract_response returns 'final answer'.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/sdk/agents/response_extractor.py plus a focused backend SDK test.
